meta.attribution: Server records originate from the official MCP Registry maintained by the Model Context Protocol project.
meta.disclaimer: Compatibility verdicts are derived from published registry data and documented client behaviour. No connector was executed or audited.

connector.name: Audio Delivery Network
connector.registryDescription: AI-manageable audio CDN: upload, transcode, normalize, stream & deliver audio, plus grounded docs.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.audiodelivery.net over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace net.audiodelivery. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bring your own AudioDN API key as a bearer token: 'Bearer adn_...'. Optional — knowledge/doc tools work with no key; live API tools activate when a key is sent.

env.name: ADN_API_KEY
env.description: AudioDN server-side API key (adn_...). Required for live API tools; knowledge/doc tools work without it.

env.name: ADN_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the AudioDN API base URL. Defaults to https://api.audiodelivery.net.

env.name: ADN_MCP_ALLOW_DELETE
env.description: Set to 1 to enable destructive delete tools. Off by default.
